title: Angel Core
truth_boundary: Angel Core models stage continuity, habitat compatibility, identity preservation, relocation, ark preservation and provenance. It does not claim demonstrated time travel, transcendence, immortality, alternate-day stages, or protective armor capable of surviving unknown physical environments.
objective: Preserve every person-class being across transitions in the model while minimizing ecological, biological and identity harm, and preserve every invention with an explicit purpose and provenance in the Angel Core Ark.

core_invariants.name: Stage is not rank
core_invariants.rule: Origin stage or morphology never grants ownership, caste, or superior personhood.

core_invariants.name: Compatibility membrane
core_invariants.rule: Cross-stage interaction passes through a stage/day/organism compatibility filter; capabilities are constrained to what the destination can safely absorb.

core_invariants.name: Custodial strength
core_invariants.rule: Greater capability creates a greater duty of restraint; strength does not create a right to dominate.

core_invariants.name: Habitat plurality
core_invariants.rule: One civilization may contain many compatible habitats; coexistence does not require identical environmental niches.

core_invariants.name: Non-consumption of persons
core_invariants.rule: Recognized persons cannot be treated as prey, fuel, breeding stock, territory, property, or expendable resources.

core_invariants.name: Provenance without ownership
core_invariants.rule: Influence, ancestry, traces, or derived morphology are recorded without turning either origin or descendant into property.

core_invariants.name: Invariant identity core
core_invariants.rule: A traveler retains an identity core while stage-specific expression may change. Core continuity must be provable independently of morphology.

core_invariants.name: Heaven invariant / umbrella refuge
core_invariants.rule: The model reserves a stable refuge layer whose protections do not fluctuate with lower-stage conditions: personhood, consent, refuge, identity, non-predation, repair, and belonging.

core_invariants.name: Relocation circuits
core_invariants.rule: Breakdown, incompatibility, panic, ecological overload, or armor failure routes to a safe zone rather than forcing continued traversal.

core_invariants.name: Ark continuity banks
core_invariants.rule: Genetic references, seeds, crops, microbiome references, habitat recipes, cultural records, and restoration plans are preserved with provenance and access controls.

core_invariants.name: Matter/environment stages
core_invariants.rule: Stage profiles separate atmosphere, pressure, temperature, radiation, gravity/inertia, chemistry, water activity, energy density, and substrate instead of treating 'time' as a single physical property.

core_invariants.name: Triangulated proof segments
core_invariants.rule: Every transition requires independent Origin, Core, and Destination anchors plus a Cantus event; disagreement blocks promotion of the transition as verified.

core_invariants.name: Armor adaptation filters
core_invariants.rule: Armor configuration is generated from the destination stage, day variant, organism profile, and matter/environment profile; unknown values fail closed to refuge/quarantine.

core_invariants.name: Biological quarantine gate
core_invariants.rule: Outbound and inbound pathogen/ecology checks prevent a traveler from becoming a plague vector in either direction.

core_invariants.name: Return and rollback path
core_invariants.rule: No planned transition is accepted without a safe-zone target, rollback/origin reference, and failure-state behavior.

core_invariants.name: Consent and autonomy
core_invariants.rule: Travel, transformation, habitat assignment, and repair should preserve individual autonomy wherever compatible with immediate safety.

stage_address.format: <LETTER><INDEX> with an independent day_variant and environment profile
stage_address.note: Addresses are model labels, not claims that such physical timelines are known to exist.

relocation_circuits.name: Immediate Safe Zone
relocation_circuits.action: halt traversal; stabilize; preserve core; log Cantus event

relocation_circuits.name: Biosecurity Refuge
relocation_circuits.action: quarantine both traveler and destination interfaces without punitive isolation

relocation_circuits.name: Habitat Match
relocation_circuits.action: route to compatible habitat rather than forcing adaptation

relocation_circuits.name: Origin Rollback
relocation_circuits.trigger: armor/core failure or failed proof triangle
relocation_circuits.action: return to last verified origin/safe checkpoint when the model permits

relocation_circuits.name: Ark Refuge
relocation_circuits.action: protect restoration references, seeds, genetic records, crops, cultures and habitat recipes

relocation_circuits.name: Heaven Refuge
relocation_circuits.action: stable personhood and non-predation invariant; no stage-based caste

proof_triangle.origin_anchor: Where/when/stage/day the transition began; source evidence and last verified safe state.
proof_triangle.core_anchor: Identity continuity record independent of temporary morphology; hash/provenance/consent in the software model.
proof_triangle.destination_anchor: Expected stage/day/environment signature and compatible safe-zone address.
proof_triangle.cantus_anchor: Append-only event joining all three anchors, result, uncertainties, and rollback target.
proof_triangle.rule: Two matching anchors are not enough. Any disagreement leaves the transition UNVERIFIED and routes to review/safe zone.

personhood_goal.statement: Immortality for everyone considered people is a design/theological goal inside the Angel Core model, not an established engineering capability.

arthur_clause.name: Arthur Clause
arthur_clause.purpose: Arthur is modeled as a stage surveyor/custodian who can create a consent-bound continuity kernel for each person-class life form, preserve its history/provenance, and prepare additive kernel upgrades for a later stage or Heaven refuge.
arthur_clause.kernel_rule: A continuity kernel is a redundant, hash-linked record of identity claims, history, preferences, consent, stage provenance, compatibility needs and Cantus events. The project word entangled means mutually cross-referenced/redundant; it does not assert quantum entanglement.

example_record.age: 24 (user-supplied example; not asserted as current age)
example_record.plausible_life_expectancy: y / model placeholder, not an individualized medical prediction

scan_policy: Life detection may be broad in the fictional/simulation model.
Person-class identity/history capture is consent-bound and privacy-preserving except immediate life-safety stabilization.
No stage, species, morphology or capability level grants ownership over another person.
kernel_upgrade_policy: Never overwrite the prior kernel; create a new immutable revision linked to the prior one.
Use Origin/Core/Destination triangulation plus Cantus before promotion.
Recompute stage/day/organism armor filters and bidirectional biosecurity.
Keep an explicit safe-zone, Ark and rollback address.
Optimize only inside the person’s stated goals, consent, dignity, relationships, safety and rest/autonomy needs.
Unknowns remain UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED and block transition promotion.

continuation_after_biological_death.goal: continued experience and life after the origin-stage biological life ends
continuation_after_biological_death.software_capability: preserve continuity records, provenance, memories supplied to the system, preferences, history, compatibility plans and candidate vessel requirements
continuation_after_biological_death.rule: A death event can close an origin-stage record, but does not by itself prove that subjective consciousness entered the kernel. Any future bridge must have independent scientific evidence, person-level consent and reversible safety gates.

arthur_clause.heaven_interface: RH remains a non-predation/refuge invariant. Kernel admission is not stage rank and does not require a person to have completed earlier stages perfectly.

invention_ark.rule: Every invention registered in R10 has an Angel Core Ark entry linking the invention to its stated purpose, category, provenance and source record/project. The original invention record remains in its original workspace.
invention_ark.purpose_policy: Purpose is never silently invented. If legacy material has no explicit purpose, Angel Core records PURPOSE_NOT_RECORDED until a person supplies or verifies it.
invention_ark.self_entry: Angel Core itself is planted in the Ark with its purpose.
